title: Unit Event — Our Constellation of Song — Episode6 Gratitude

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has done it at last. They've been signed by a record label! Reflecting on all of the people whose support has taken them this far, Ichika thinks of a way for the band to show their gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, this seems like the right place...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki. Thank goodness I found you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena and Emu are just over there.
They said Honami also invited them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, we should see the show together!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, let's. I'm very much looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...! There's so many people here now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and they're all here to see us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Standing here really brings back memories of when we played in front of an audience for the very first time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. As nostalgic as that is, I felt so nervous that time... But now, I think my excitement is winning out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We've done a bunch of shows since then, but I've had fun every single time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's make this our best performance yet.
Sounds like you're all more than ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much for coming.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And thank you for booking this venue for us. We couldn't be more grateful...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I was just doing my job as your manager.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Plus, I'm personally looking forward to seeing Leo/need play...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Mr. Shindo...
There's actually something I've been meaning to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
For giving a band of high schoolers like us a chance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've been meaning to thank you for quite a while now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's always been my dream to become a professional musician. I can't say that it's come true yet since we still haven't actually made our debut, but it's within my grasp now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This show is about thanking all those who've been there for us along the way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that includes you, Mr. Shindo. So, we hope you really enjoy it to the end.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because we're gonna make it a good one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, me! I wanna go next!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't thank you enough, Mr. Shindo!
You gave me the push I needed to actually decide on going pro!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, we're gonna do our very best to show you our appreciation today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we're going to do what we can to make you feel glad that you decided to take a chance with us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's do our usual thing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, get your star pieces ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's been a long journey...
We'd drifted far apart, but ended up getting our band back together. We even decided to try to go pro, which led us here...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we have so many people to thank for making this happen.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, let's give them a proper thank you. Let's give them the best show they've ever seen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I really can't wait since Hoshino sounded so eager...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all for joining us here today!
